about: An S61 from Sonoff's firmware to OpenBeken, its bootloader refusing the OpenBeken sent to it each of the three times a run sends it (simulated: an S61's run sends a refused image again, unasked once Sonoff's firmware is seen still answering (arrival.still_on_sonoff), up to runner.GO_BACK_LIMIT times - never asking for the device to be switched off and on, which would not install it): the run fails, then What next tries the device again, which carries on from where it stopped and converts it

answers.when: Which firmware should the device have

shows: not installed: the device still answers on Sonoff's firmware
